notes: Sits alongside the four separate `blocks*` booleans: an exception must be able to block NOTHING, and the system must be able to tell that apart from blocking a freeze.

canaries.assertion: Dropping `ready-with-warning` from EXECUTABLE_DISPOSITIONS fails three tests, including the executable-count and amber-is-not-refusal canaries. Mutation-verified.

statement: A warning is not a refusal: a record carrying an accepted, disclosed warning remains executable.

occurrences.defect: A single `blocking: boolean` collapsed the distinction between an exception that blocks nothing at all and one that blocks a freeze, so all amber notices were treated alike and every warned record was excluded from the executable cohort.
